decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Network & 3G Information, Health & Safety Statement, 101 Rev. A, 102 Rev. A, 103 Rev. A, 104 Rev. A and 200 Rev. A Received: 13 September 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - As soon as reasonably practicable after it is no longer required for telecommunications purposes the development hereby approved, shall be removed from the site, and the land restored to its condition before the development took place, or to any other condition as previously agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
description: The replacement of 6 no. antennas with 3 no. antennas in, the addition of 1 no. 0.6m dish, the removal of 1 no. cabinet and addition of 2 no. cabinets on the rooftop at Beverley Court.
